body:
## What's a good price for AirPods Pro 3?

Apple sells the AirPods Pro 3 for £219, and it never discounts them itself. At other retailers:

- **£200 (today at Amazon):** a fair price, but not a deal to rush for.
- **Under £190:** a good price. They were around £183 at Amazon during October's Prime Big Deal Days, and £30 off earlier in November.
- **£175 or less:** excellent. That's the lowest price recorded, and the one to wait for if you can.

Amazon's Black Friday Week runs from 19 to 30 November, with Black Friday itself on 27 November. Many of Amazon's best prices are for Prime members only, so if you're not a member, the [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) is worth starting just before you buy. Our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time it.

## AirPods Pro 3 vs AirPods Pro 2

The AirPods Pro 3 replaced the Pro 2 in September 2025. Compared with the Pro 2, they cancel more noise, add heart-rate tracking for workouts, last longer per charge and come with more ear-tip sizes. Apple no longer sells the Pro 2, and we couldn't find them from a major UK retailer at a sensible price today.

If you see "AirPods Pro" for much less than £175, check which generation they are and who's selling them. Old Pro 2 stock is worth it only well under £150, and only from a retailer you trust.

## Pro 3 or cheaper AirPods?

The main difference is the fit. The Pro models have silicone tips that seal in your ear. That's what makes their noise cancelling much stronger than any other AirPods, and why they suit commuters and frequent flyers.

- **AirPods Pro 3 (£200):** best noise cancelling, heart-rate sensor, best for travel and the gym.
- **AirPods 5 (£119):** open fit with no tips, noise cancelling as standard. Good for people who find in-ear tips uncomfortable.
- **AirPods 4 with ANC (£109 at John Lewis):** the older open-fit model, now cheaper than the AirPods 5. Fine for quiet places; it won't hush a train like the Pro 3.
- **AirPods Max 2 (£449):** over-ear headphones with the richest sound, but heavy and costly.

For most people who want noise cancelling that works, the Pro 3 are worth the extra £80 or so over the AirPods 5.

## Where to buy

Stick to Amazon (sold and dispatched by Amazon), Apple, John Lewis, Currys, Argos and other big retailers. Fake AirPods Pro are common on marketplaces, eBay and social media ads, and they look convincing in photos. A price far below £175 for brand-new Pro 3 is a warning sign.

Buying from Amazon also means a simple return if they don't fit. Amazon's extended Christmas returns usually let gifts bought from November be returned until the end of January, but check the dates on the listing.

For the whole AirPods range and last year's Black Friday prices, see our [AirPods Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/). For other Black Friday prices, see [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) and our [Black Friday 2026 live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/).

### What is the cheapest AirPods Pro price in the UK?

The AirPods Pro 3 are £200 at Amazon (checked 17 November 2026), £19 under Apple's £219 price. The lowest they've been is about £175.

### Will AirPods Pro be cheaper on Black Friday?

Probably. The Pro 3 are now a year old and have already dropped below £190 twice this autumn. Amazon's Black Friday Week (19 to 30 November) is the most likely time for another cut.

### Are AirPods Pro 2 still worth buying?

Only at a big discount from a trusted retailer. The Pro 3 cancel more noise and track heart rate, and Apple no longer sells the Pro 2. At £200, the Pro 3 are the better buy.

### Do AirPods Pro 3 work with Android?

Yes, as Bluetooth earbuds with noise cancelling, but you lose iPhone features like automatic switching, the hearing tools and easy settings. Android users will usually get more for their money from other brands.
